literal: In the ear taste who do not perceive, mouth possessing perception base people, even if they perish even if they live, what?
translation: What does it matter whether those base people live or die, who know only the taste of the mouth and not the taste of the ear?
modern: செவியால் அறியும் கேள்வியின் சுவையை உணராமல், வாயால் அறியும் உணவின் சுவையை மட்டுமே உணரும் மனிதர்கள் வாழ்ந்தால் என்ன, இறந்தால் என்ன?
explanation: This couplet contrasts the intellectual pleasure of listening with the physical pleasure of eating. The phrase 'செவியில் சுவை உணரா' refers to those who do not appreciate the taste of knowledge gained through the ear. They are described as 'வாய் உணர்வின் மாக்கள்', base people who only understand the taste of the mouth. The poet asks what difference it makes whether such unrefined individuals live or die, as their existence contributes nothing of higher value to the world.
